title: Performance v0.1
description: Raw observed platform metrics snapshot for one video at one observation time. Normalized labels, residual targets, virality scores, and ranker outputs are deliberately excluded.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; null when not derivable.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC moment the snapshot was taken.

age_since_publish_seconds.description: observed_at - published_at in seconds; null when published_at is null. Must be derivable when both timestamps are present.

metrics.description: Raw counters. null = unknown/not exposed by the platform. 0 always means observed zero, never unknown. Values must be non-negative integers.

saves.description: Include only when truly available from the platform payload; otherwise null.

follower_count_at_observation.description: Creator follower count if publicly available at observation time; null otherwise.

collector.description: Provenance needed to audit this snapshot.

method.description: How metrics were obtained (e.g. metadata endpoint, page scrape).

raw_payload_reference.description: Path/URI to the immutable raw collector payload backing this snapshot.

notes.description: Free-text audit notes; never used for derived labels.

$comment: Cross-field consistency (age_since_publish_seconds vs published_at/observed_at, within 1s tolerance) is enforced by semantic validation in code; JSON Schema cannot express timestamp arithmetic.
